evidence_text: Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme metadata: accurate elevation data at 1 m spatial resolution for all England; products in 5 km tiles aligned to the Ordnance Survey grid; tile names carry unique survey id, OS grid reference and first/last survey dates; index catalogue provides survey-specific tile information; DTM filters surface objects to ground, DSM includes ground and surface objects, surface models are GeoTIFF and point cloud is LAZ; EPSG:27700; vertical accuracy +/-0.15 m RMSE; quarterly publication; metadata revision 2023-12-15; reference period 2016-11-11 through 2023-05-05; Open Government Licence; no public access constraints. Target remains BUILDING_PRESENT; spatial binding/raster sampling/materialization and height-difference calculation remain local-only.
